incompatible_target: The selected printer cannot run this target model.
compatible_fallback_disabled: Routing to a compatible printer model is disabled. Review the AutoQueue compatibility setting.
autoqueue_more_issues_one: And {count} more issue. Open AutoQueue for the full list.
autoqueue_more_issues_few: And {count} more issues. Open AutoQueue for the full list.
autoqueue_more_issues_many: And {count} more issues. Open AutoQueue for the full list.
plate_selection_required: Select one printable plate from this file.
plate_not_found: The selected plate is not in this file.
plate_gcode_missing: The selected plate has no sliced G-code.
invalid_plate_metadata: Plate metadata is invalid or ambiguous.
ambiguous_plate_gcode: Multiple G-code files describe the same plate.
slice_info_missing: This file has no sliced plate metadata.
invalid_project_settings: The file has invalid slicer settings.
invalid_printer_model: The file has invalid printer model metadata.
filament_usage_unavailable: Cannot determine all filament channels used by this plate.
filament_type_unavailable: A used filament channel has no material type.
nozzle_mapping_unavailable: Cannot determine which nozzle each filament needs.
source_changed: The source file changed. Reload its requirements.
source_unreadable: The source file is missing or unreadable. Restore access to the file, then retry the job.
source_timeout: The source file did not respond in time. Check the storage connection, then retry the job.
source_check_busy: Waiting for a file-check worker to become available.
source_retry_not_failed: Only a failed auto-queue job can be retried.
printer_waking: Printer is waking up; waiting for a fresh connection.
printer_offline: Printer is offline; fresh filament state is required.
printer_off_missing_filament: Printer is switched off, and what it holds cannot run this job, so it is not switched on.
model_mismatch: The sliced printer model does not match.
nozzle_mismatch: Nozzle size or physical binding does not match.
color_unavailable: The required color cannot be verified.
color_mismatch: The required color is not loaded.
material_mismatch: No compatible filament source is available.
variant_mismatch: The filament variant does not match.
feed_topology_mismatch: The available feeds cannot switch all required channels.
fts_external_unsupported: External filament cannot be used while Filament Track Switch is connected.
fts_state_unavailable: Waiting for the printer to confirm whether Filament Track Switch is still connected.
tpu_left_firmware_unavailable: Waiting for the firmware TPU capability of the left nozzle.
tpu_left_firmware_unsupported: Current firmware does not support TPU on the left nozzle.
distinct_sources_required: Each used channel needs a separate compatible source.
override_slot_not_used: A channel override refers to an unused slot.
feed_state_changed: The filament in a slot this print uses changed while it was being prepared, so it was not started.
dispatch_claim_changed: This dispatch attempt no longer owns the queue item.
source_read_forbidden: You do not have permission to read this source.
feed_state_unavailable: Waiting for current AMS and external feed configuration.
feed_settle_timeout: The printer did not report its filament state in time, so the print was not started.
pinned_source_empty: The slot chosen for this print is empty, and no AMS Backup slot can stand in for it.
planned_source_empty: A slot this print uses stayed empty, so it was not started.
printer_reconnected: The printer reconnected just before the print would start, so it was not started.
source_copy_busy: The queue is already copying files. Try again in a moment.
source_spool_replaced: A restore replaced the saved queue files. Try again.
source_invalid: The source file is not a readable sliced file.
source_copy_timeout: Copying the source timed out. Check that its storage is available before retrying.
source_spool_no_space: There is not enough free space to save this file for the queue.
source_spool_write_failed: The file could not be saved for the queue. Check the server's data storage.
source_copy_failed: The file could not be saved for the queue.
auto_eject_conflict: Finish G-code auto-eject conflicts with printer Swap Mode
plate_check_unavailable: Could not obtain or analyse a fresh plate image
plate_objects_detected: Objects remain on the plate; inspect the part and purge cube zones
plate_manual_inspection: The previous run requires inspection and a run-bound manual plate answer
plate_context_changed: Printer or dispatch context changed; a fresh check is required
plate_telemetry_unavailable: Fresh local printer telemetry is unavailable
swap_source_unknown: This file's source does not say whether it carries its own plate-swap sequence, so BamDude does not run its swap macros for it. Print it with the swap macros off, or from a source whose declaration is known.
swap_cycle_started: The table-swap cycle started but did not finish. Inspect the mechanism and plate before resuming.
swap_cycle_possibly_started: The table-swap cycle may have started, but completion is unconfirmed. Inspect the mechanism and plate before resuming.
swap_hold_source_unknown: The table swap was not run: this print's source does not say whether it carries its own plate-swap sequence. Inspect the plate, then resume the queue.
swap_hold_source_baked: The table swap was not run: this print's source carries its own plate-swap sequence, so BamDude's would have been a second one. Inspect the plate, then resume the queue.
swap_hold_run_unproven: The table swap was not run: this finish could not be tied to the print BamDude started. Inspect the plate, then resume the queue.
swap_hold_not_completed: The print did not complete, so the table swap was not run. Inspect and clear the plate, then resume the queue.
swap_hold_swap_off: The table swap was not run: swap mode is off on this printer or its change-table macro is missing. Run the table swap or clear the plate, then resume the queue.
swap_hold_outcome_uncertain: The table swap was not run: the print's outcome is uncertain after the outage. Inspect the plate, then resume the queue.
swap_hold_macro_error: The table swap did not finish: BamDude could not run the printer's change-table macro. Inspect the mechanism and plate, then resume the queue.
swap_hold_attempt_unknown: The table swap may already have run: BamDude cannot confirm whether the change-table macro went out or finished, so it is not sent again. Inspect the mechanism and plate, then resume the queue.
routing_unclassified: Routing could not determine a supported reason. Review this job in AutoQueue.
autoqueue_more_issues: And {count} more issues. Open AutoQueue for the full list.
farm_recovery_hold: New starts are held while the farm recovers. Check the startup banner.
printer_busy_at_start: The printer became busy just before the print would start, so it was not started.
printer_not_connected: The printer was not connected when the print would start, so it was not started.
start_refused: The printer did not take the start command, so the print was not started.
stale_execution_claim: This stale queue claim cannot be retried or cloned. Check its execution archive.
